IPL Cricketer and Retired IPS Father Face FIR for Alleged Cook Assault

An FIR has been registered against Indian Premier League cricketer Shashank Singh and his retired IPS father, Shailesh Singh, in Bhopal. The complaint was filed by their domestic cook, who alleges assault, abuse, and being held captive. Police have initiated an investigation into the matter.
